description: Compares the runtime bytecode of two Ethereum contracts you name: the share of shared PUSH4 function selectors (Jaccard) and the cosine similarity of their opcode frequencies, combined into one 0 to 1 score with a SIMILAR, PARTIAL or DIFFERENT label. It compares two addresses only; it has no database of known scam or exploit templates, so it cannot say a contract is a known clone. Choose this tool for: Compares the runtime bytecode of two Ethereum contracts you. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_deployer_rug_forensics (Contracts created by a deployer wallet on Ethereum); agent_intel_anti_whale_limit_detector (Static search of a VERIFIED Ethereum contract's Solidity). Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
